_comment: Swimlane field tier resolution (#2439). Shared by backend boards/tests/test_lane_field_tiers_2439.py (resolve_tiers in boards/services/lane_field_tiers.py) and frontend src/test/laneFieldTiersParity.test.ts (resolveLaneTiers in src/utils/laneBand.ts), so a rule change on one side fails CI until the other follows. Each case lists definitions as [id, position, band_visibility] and the expected tier per id.

cases.name: legacy: first two by position are band, the rest details, uncapped
materialized: explicit tiers win over position
mixed: a null row is never band and fills details up to the cap
mixed: details already full sends a null row to hidden
